test_title: PYST 52: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Someone who pretends to have certain moral standards while secretively that person practices those very moral lapses.
solution:
The **correct answer **is **Option 4 **i.e. **Hypocrite**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hypocrite**: A person who pretends to have virtues, moral or religious beliefs, principles, etc., that he or she does not actually possess, especially a person whose actions belie stated beliefs.

 
 
• **Example**: Despite publicly advocating for a vegetarian lifestyle, John secretly eats meat, making him a hypocrite.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Hypocrite**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sinner**: A person who transgresses against divine law by committing an immoral act or acts. 
 
• **Actor**: A person whose profession is acting on the stage, in movies, or on television.
 
• **Spy**: A person who secretly collects and reports information on the activities, movements, and plans of an enemy or competitor.
